Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODLink

GetChangeTime

The GetChangeTime method returns the time of the last update to the link source content. 
ODTime GetChangeTime ();
return value
The time when the link source content was last updated.
SEE ALSO
The ODTime type (page 877).
"Updating a Link at the Destination" on page 384 in OpenDoc Programmer's Guide.
